summary: Added approved as an allowed RegulatoryNotification status
reason: A rule requires Regulatory Notification status to be approved before submission, but the class property value set omitted approved.
agentImpact: The agent can now evaluate and execute sendRegulatoryNotification without referencing a status value outside the model.
before: RegulatoryNotification.status allowed: draft, pending-approval, submitted, accepted, rejected
after: RegulatoryNotification.status allowed: draft, pending-approval, approved, submitted, accepted, rejected
evidence: “The agent should only be allowed to submit the regulatory notification when the status is approved.” (Turn 42 persona)
